programs.explicit_statement:
∀ (n : Nat) (state : Counters.State) (delta : Counters.Count) (v : LeanGo.Validate.Value),
  LeanGo.Validated.prog.run n "Counters.advance"
        [LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode state, LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode delta] =
      some v →
    v = LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode (Counters.advance state delta)

cases.statement:
LeanGo.Validated.prog.run 64 "Counters.advance"
    [LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode { count := { value := 0 }, total := 1, enabled := false },
      LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode { value := 1 }] =
  some
    (LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode
      (Counters.advance { count := { value := 0 }, total := 1, enabled := false } { value := 1 }))

LeanGo.Validated.prog.run 64 "Counters.advance"
    [LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode { count := { value := 1 }, total := 18446744073709551615, enabled := true },
      LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode { value := 4294967295 }] =
  some
    (LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode
      (Counters.advance { count := { value := 1 }, total := 18446744073709551615, enabled := true }
        { value := 4294967295 }))

LeanGo.Validated.prog.run 64 "Counters.advance"
    [LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode
        { count := { value := 4294967295 }, total := 11944489850714860875, enabled := false },
      LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode { value := 2781043260 }] =
  some
    (LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode
      (Counters.advance { count := { value := 4294967295 }, total := 11944489850714860875, enabled := false }
        { value := 2781043260 }))

LeanGo.Validated.prog.run 64 "Counters.advance"
    [LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode { count := { value := 2781043260 }, total := 0, enabled := true },
      LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode { value := 0 }] =
  some
    (LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode
      (Counters.advance { count := { value := 2781043260 }, total := 0, enabled := true } { value := 0 }))

  some (LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode (Counters.initial 0 1 false))

LeanGo.Validated.prog.run 64 "Counters.initial"
    [LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode 1, LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode 18446744073709551615,
      LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode true] =
  some (LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode (Counters.initial 1 18446744073709551615 true))

LeanGo.Validated.prog.run 64 "Counters.initial"
    [LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode 4294967295, LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode 11944489850714860875,
      LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode false] =
  some (LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode (Counters.initial 4294967295 11944489850714860875 false))

LeanGo.Validated.prog.run 64 "Counters.initial"
    [LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode 2781043260, LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode 0, LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode true] =
  some (LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode (Counters.initial 2781043260 0 true))
